name: GoldenHome Living Co., Ltd.
summary: GoldenHome Living Co., Ltd., headquartered in Xiamen, China, is dedicated to the full lifecycle of integrated kitchen cabinetry and a variety of customized, intelligent home furnishings within the Chinese market. This encompasses everything from initial research, design, and development to production, sales, installation, and post-purchase service. Complementing its core offerings, the company also provides wardrobes, wooden doors, and smart home appliances. GoldenHome distributes its products through an extensive retail footprint throughout China, consisting of 1,585 kitchen cabinet stores, 722 Jujia brand wardrobe outlets, and 181 Jujia wooden door stores. The company was founded in 1999.
